meta.title: A website, Instagram and direct guests for villas and holiday homes | SvojSmeštaj
meta.description: For owners of villas, holiday cottages and luxury apartments: a premium website, 30 days of Instagram management and ads that bring guests to you directly, commission-free. €990, with a guarantee of at least 10 inquiries.

heroEyebrow: For owners of villas, holiday cottages and luxury apartments
heroLede: For €990 you get a premium website, 30 days of Instagram management and €100 invested in ads for your property. We guarantee at least 10 guest inquiries.
exampleTitle: This is what our websites look like.
exampleLede: So far we've built websites for villas, holiday cottages and apartments in Serbia, Montenegro and Greece. Now we work only with villas and holiday homes.
calcTitle: How much does commission cost you per year?
calcLede: Enter your nightly rate and occupancy.
calcLostYear: That's what you give platforms each year
calcNote: The calculation uses a 15% commission. Booking.com charges hosts around 15-18% per booking, and Airbnb up to 16% when the host pays the full fee - your real loss is probably higher.
faqA1: Owners of villas, holiday cottages, holiday homes and luxury apartments with something to show: a view, a pool, nature or design. Our focus is on the Montenegrin coast, Zlatibor, Kopaonik, Tara, Jahorina and similar destinations.
faqA3: Any message or call from a guest via the website, Instagram or WhatsApp.
faqQ4: What if I don't get 10 inquiries?
faqA4: We keep running your Instagram for free until you do. There are no refunds; the guarantee is that we keep working.
faqQ5: My property only runs in season. When do the ads start?
faqA5: The 30 days start when the ads go live. For off-season properties we agree together on when the ads start, so they run when guests are looking.
faqQ6: How long does the website take?
faqA6: Usually less than a week from when you send us photos and details. After that we set up Instagram and launch the ads.
faqQ7: Do I have to leave Booking and Airbnb?
faqA7: No. The calendar on your website is synced with them, so you can keep them as an extra channel and slowly reduce your dependence on them.
faqA8: The full amount is paid upfront, after a short talk where we check that the package is right for your property.
testimonialsNote: These are reviews from our real clients.
testimonialsStoriesTitle: From our Instagram: messages from clients
testimonialsStoryAlt: Instagram story with a client review
t1Quote: Working with the SvojSmeštaj team was excellent. The website they built shows my holiday home in the best possible light and makes it very easy for guests to find me on Google. Guests now contact me by phone far more often, which suits both of us.
t2Quote: The website I have now nicely presents all the units in my apartments in one place. People often reach out through the site now, which suits me a lot. At the same time I've kept using Booking and Airbnb, so everything works just as it should.
t3Quote: The collaboration went great - I had the first version of the site within a couple of days. After a single consultation, I got exactly the website I had in mind. The integrations work perfectly, I don't get double bookings, and people now contact me directly, so I often give them better terms and earn more myself since there's no commission. Highly recommended.

heroTitle: Own a villa, a holiday cottage or a luxury apartment?
problemTitle: On Booking you're one of hundreds of similar listings.
problemLede: For that visibility the platform takes 15–20% of every booking, and your property is still compared on price alone.
problem1Text: Guests scroll through hundreds of listings and choose by price. Your view, pool, nature and design get lost in the crowd.
problem2Text: On a property that earns €30,000 a year, that's €4,500–6,000 you hand over to the platform.
problem3Text: The platform keeps the guest's contact. Next year they book through it again, not directly with you.
solutionTitle: A website, Instagram and your first guests, directly.
solutionLede: Booking and Airbnb can stay. We build you a channel that's only yours and bring the first guests to it.
solution1Text: Your property's story, large photos and a booking inquiry. Guests see why you, not just the price.
solution2Text: For 30 days we run your profile: posts and reels that show the view, the pool, the nature and the atmosphere.
solution3Text: We launch ads for your property and bring guests to your website and Instagram, so they contact you directly.

guaranteeText: If you don't get at least 10 inquiries within 30 days of the ads going live, we keep running your Instagram for free until you do.
guaranteeTerm1: An inquiry is a message or call from a guest via the website, Instagram or WhatsApp.
guaranteeTerm2: You send photos and details on time and reply to inquiries.
guaranteeTerm3: The period starts when the ads go live. For off-season properties we agree together on when the ads start.
guaranteeTerm4: No refunds. The guarantee is that we keep working, at no extra cost.

priceItem2: 30 days of Instagram management, 9–10 posts and reels
priceItem3: €100 invested in ads for your property
priceAfterText: If you like working with us, we keep running your Instagram and bringing guests through the season. We agree on it together, based on your property's season.
faqQ2: I have a regular apartment in the city. Is this for me?
faqA2: This package is built for properties with a story. If you only need a simple website, without Instagram and ads, we also have a basic package, so just message us.
faqA10: Whatever suits you better: we can buy and manage the domain for you, or you can buy it in your own name.
faqA11: Yes. We work with property owners in Serbia, Montenegro, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia and Albania.
